audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases.side (Nami, Nami, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill) contradicts content-layer win[] (Skill, Skill, Nami x5) on every row.
audit.why: The packet's levelChart and win[]/whys[] already agree: even level 1-2 poke stalemate, Nami pulling ahead from level 3 once her Q-stun sets up kill windows and snowballing through W bounce-poke, R teamfight start, and E auto-empower. The full-layer phases were never aligned to that.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[0-1].side to Skill and phases[2-6].side to Nami, rewriting each .why to match the content narrative.

audit.why: Spikes correctly identify level 6 (Tidal Wave knock-up starting fights on her terms vs Wish's pure heal) and first item (Ebb and Flow bounce-poke out-tempoing single-target Starcall) as Nami's power spikes, grounded in her kit.
